audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 on a 50.12% lane over 2063 games, and six of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror set the chart to the packet: Sylas, Skill, Graves, Skill, Graves, Graves, Sylas. My full and content layers both read Graves x4 then Skill x3.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped in both layers as one atomic group with ratings and phase whys rewritten; diff set EVEN 5.5/10 with the EVEN tone token used elsewhere on this champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Sylas spike in the full layer while the content layer said the opposite.
audit.why: Collateral Damage is 100/80/60 and is pure damage — stealing it adds burst but no repositioning, so 6 genuinely is not the flip in this lane. Riftmaker plus Shadowflame at two items is.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/[5] whys rewritten to Graves and the two-item row given to Sylas, matching the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabrications: an ability called 'Buckshot', Smoke Screen described as a blind that stops your casts, and Collateral Damage described as an escape.
audit.why: Riot's kit has no Buckshot — the shotgun is the passive New Destiny, four bullets that cannot pass through units. Smoke Screen 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range' with a brief slow — it cuts vision, not casting. Collateral Damage 'fires an explosive shell... explodes dealing damage in a cone' — no displacement of any kind, so 'save R as an escape' is advice that gets a player killed.
audit.corrected: Shotgun described as his four-bullet passive, Smoke Screen restated as a 26s sight-range cut, Collateral Damage restated as 100s damage with no displacement — in mid, late, breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[1], wants.foe[1] and report[5].

audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12 at 425 range, refreshed by his basic attacks — 16s at rank 1 is the window your hook needs.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and the phase whys.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'His Collateral Damage' — correct Riot name. False positive; the real defect was the fabricated 'Buckshot' the checker did not flag.

edits.before: Full kit: E2 chain into Q-W-AA is a real chunk, and E1's shield eats the counter-trade. Trade in full rotations.

edits.before: Weave passive autos between every spell. Trade around Quickdraw and bank small HP leads — they compound at 6.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.

edits.before: That is Graves’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.

edits.after: Track Quickdraw (E): 16s at rank 1, a 425-range dash that stacks armour and MR, refreshed by his autos. Hook after it.

edits.before: At level 1 Graves only has Buckshot — a short-range cone that punishes you heavily if you walk into it, but your Q Chain Lash out-ranges it, letting you poke him off CS without eating the spread. Farm with the tip of Q and do not step up into his auto range. The moment you hit level 2 and he does not, respect that he is one E-dash away from a Buckshot-at-point-blank trade that hurts; keep the wave pushed so he is the one walking forward into your Q zones.
edits.after: At level 1 Graves only has his shotgun — four bullets in a short cone that punish you heavily if you walk into it, but your 775-range Q Chain Lash out-ranges it, letting you poke him off CS without eating the spread. Farm with the tip of Q and do not step up into his auto range. The moment you hit level 2 and he does not, respect that his 425-range Quickdraw is one dash away from a point-blank trade that hurts; keep the wave pushed so he is the one walking forward into your Q zones.

edits.before: Level 3 is when this lane goes against you — Graves has Buckshot, Smoke Screen, and Quickdraw all live. His smoke blinds your Q cast animation and his dash keeps him at the exact spacing where shotgun spread deals maximum damage. Do not use E2 hook to initiate unless his Quickdraw is on cooldown; he will simply dash through the chain and burst you while you are mid-animation. At level 6 his Collateral Damage R is explosive burst you cannot steal for meaningful value — it is a skillshot escape tool on Sylas, not a win condition — so this matchup lacks your defining level-6 power spike. Play through the jungle, track his own Quickdraw cooldown, and take small Q-poke leads rather than all-ins.
edits.after: Level 3 is when this lane goes against you — Graves has his shotgun, Smoke Screen, and Quickdraw all live. The smoke cuts your sight range rather than your casting, and his 16-second dash holds the exact spacing where the four-bullet spread deals maximum damage. Do not use E2 hook to initiate unless Quickdraw is on cooldown; he will simply dash through the chain and burst you while you are mid-animation. At level 6 his Collateral Damage is a 100-second skillshot with no displacement on it at all — real damage, but it repositions neither of you — so this matchup lacks your defining level-6 power spike. Play through the jungle, track Quickdraw's 16 seconds, and take small Q-poke leads rather than all-ins.

edits.before: At two items your Riftmaker omnivamp and Shadowflame magic penetration finally make the extended trade loop work — his shotgun burst still hurts but your W heal closes the deficit faster than he can reset the pattern. Force fights in tight sideline corridors where his Quickdraw dash has nowhere to carry him outside your chain range; open-field skirmishes still favor him. His Collateral Damage remains a burst-escape that is useless on you, so your stolen R is a non-factor all game — win this through sustained brawling and map pressure, not through the ultimate theft that defines your best matchups.
edits.after: At two items your Riftmaker omnivamp and Shadowflame magic penetration finally make the extended trade loop work — his shotgun burst still hurts but your W heal closes the deficit faster than he can reset the pattern. Force fights in tight sideline corridors where his 425-range Quickdraw has nowhere to carry him outside your chain range; open-field skirmishes still favor him. Collateral Damage is pure cone damage with no displacement, so the stolen R adds burst rather than a repositioning tool — win this through sustained brawling and map pressure, not through the ultimate theft that defines your best matchups.

notes: The fabricated ability 'Buckshot' appeared in four places and the packet's defect checker never flagged it — it only flagged a correct name. Worth a checker note. Left alone deliberately (same call as the mirror): the fields calling Sylas's E a stun. Not asserted: whether Smoke Screen's sight cut affects targeting of the E recast in practice — Riot's text says sight range only.
